item: settings write slot: the in-flight count is one add of a token and an idempotent discard
summary: _write_slot counted a save in flight in two statements (an integer incremented, then a flag set), so an interrupt between them could leave a count for ever (every later hold refused to start until a restart) and the reverse order could release a write that was never counted (a hold starting with a save still writing the old file). The count is now a set of tokens: one add counts, a discard releases, and releasing a token that was never added does nothing. Two planted interrupts (after and before the add) with another write in flight, and two mutants (clear instead of discard, release disabled) are caught. Also checked and left alone: the static walk over volume_job.py is already in test_p0_validation _GUARDED_MODULES (backup/volume_job), and the posonly and IfExp mutants of the merge-writes scan are caught by the current planted cases (the earlier survivors were from a file state before those cases)
